newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen opposition parties say 12 members arrested.
newsitem.headline: Yemen opposition parties say 12 members arrested.

text.p: Yemeni opposition parties on Wednesday said 12 members of one of their movements were arrested overnight in three southern provinces.
The parties said in a statement that supporters of the Sons of Yemen League party were arrested in their homes during the night in Hadramaut, Aden and Lahaj.
The statement -- issued by the Sons of Yemen League, the Yemen Socialist Party (YSP) and two smaller groups -- named the the 12.

The deputy director general of security in Aden denied that any arrests had been made in the port city. The opposition had said one man was arrested in Aden. Security officials in other provinces were not immediately available for comment.
All four parties boycotted this year's general election, but the YSP has traditionally been a political force. Some of the YSP's leaders launched a secessionist bid which sparked the 1994 civil war.
The statement did not say why the members were being held.
The parties said they had called on their members to hold a peaceful demonstration against the alleged arrests in the southern port city of Mukalla on Thursday.
